_about: ICP: sales leaders, AEs and SEs at 21-200 person B2B software companies in India. Keys starting with _ are notes and are not sent.
_values: Location and industry strings must match Prospeo's own vocabulary exactly. Get valid values free from the Search Suggestions API: POST https://api.prospeo.io/search-suggestions with {"location_search": "..."} or {"industry_search": "..."}.
_widen: Too few results? Raise max_person_per_company to 3, then add "201-500" to the headcount range. Adding back "IT Services and IT Consulting" widens a lot but fills the list with services firms and system integrators, not SaaS sales teams.
